record.question: The crystal structure of austenite is
record.explanation: Austenite (gamma iron) has a face-centered cubic crystal structure. Inspection of printed question 23 on PDF page 3 confirms that the options instead list body centered cubic, base centered cubic, hexagonal closed packed, and body centered tetragonal; none is correct. The item is held because the correct option is missing; base centered cubic cannot silently be changed to face centered cubic.
